Built around the working day

From first weigh-in
to final settlement.

Each step keeps the original weight, rate and operator trail together—designed for fast operation and accountable corrections.

01WEIGH

Record the leaf

Supplier, route, gross weight and approved deductions in a keyboard-friendly POS.

02CALCULATE

Confirm the payable

Precise net weight, rate, allowances and deductions with a preserved calculation snapshot.

03PRINT

Issue the bill

Save first, then print a Sinhala, English or bilingual receipt on the selected local printer.

04SETTLE

Close with confidence

Track payments, outstanding balances, cash closing and linked accounting entries.
